x.h:
Welcome to Havana Haven BnB!
Here at your fingertips is everything you should need for your stay with us in Fort Lauderdale. In this easy-to-navigate link you will find information about the home, ideas and recommendations in the surrounding area, our Wi-Fi login credentials, and so much more.

In order to best enjoy your time in our home, we encourage you to add this "app" to your phone. All of the content will even be accessible when your phone is offline.

* It's not really an "app", but more a tool for easy access on your home screen

  • For iPhone:
    • Tap the square with arrow pointing up at the bottom of your screen
    • Select "Add to Home Screen"
  • For Android:
    • Tap "Add to Home Screen" where prompted when first accessing the site

Print or Save a PDF
If you would like to print certain pages ahead of traveling, or if you'd like to save a PDF to your device, just tap the print button above. It won't print right away, but will create a PDF which you can save or print.

Contacting Us
We pride ourselves on swiftly meeting guest needs. We can be reached as follows:

  • Preferred: Airbnb or VRBO message
  • Phone: 404-358-1552 (emergencies)
  • Instagram: @Bk_stays
  • Facebook: BK Stays

What Next?
Please relax, unwind, have fun, and enjoy your stay!

Brandon & Katharina have been to Fort Lauderdale many times, however, our first trip (as a family) was just recently in January of 2022 and we fell further in love. The surrounding area has so much to offer for families, friends, and couples during every season of the year. The Oakland Park community vibes left such a good impression that we made the decision as a family to find our home away from home - Havana Haven. We haven’t yet had the chance to experience everything South Florida has to offer and have a long bucket list waiting for our next adventure. We have a 4-year-old daughter and a 1-year-old son, and absolutely love traveling and spending time exploring new places as a family.

Use Waze and/or Google Maps.

Otherwise - if traveling on I95:

Take the exit for East/West Oakland Park Boulevard and go EAST.

Turn NORTH onto NE 20th Ave.

Merge LEFT onto NE 19th Ave.

Drive a few blocks and the home will be on your left!

The Access Code for the front door is

1552

To lock the door, simply press the lock button. Please make sure all external doors are locked whenever you leave.

* If for some reason the code doesn't work please call me at 404-358-1552. I will get you the lockbox code for the spare key!

Standard check-out is at 10:00 AM on your departure date (Unless you've paid for a late check-out). 

When you've finished your stay, technically, you can just leave no questions asked lol :) But, if you really wanted to give our cleaning team some love, we would appreciate it if you would take care of a few simple things:

  • Dishwasher - Load and start the dishwasher
  • Towels - Place all used towels in the shower.
  • Trash - Place trash in can(s) next to the garage. GREEN is Trash. BLUE is Recycling
  • Lock Up - Lock all doors

Also, for safety outdoors, please deflate the pool toys and "wind down" the umbrellas.

We hope you guys had an amazing stay! Thank you again and safe travels back home.

x.t: Thank You For Staying With Us

x.h:
There is free Wi-Fi for your use. The details are:

WIFI Name: bk stays

Do not use "Havana Haven BnB" - this network is only for the Smart TV's

The service is provided for your enjoyment but you are responsible for safe and appropriate use and complying with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact us.

There is a propane grill for your personal use on the back patio. Please follow the grill instructions carefully when using propane. Do not forget to close the valve when you're done!

We always try to keep a full tank on site - but sometimes they run out before before we can get a replacement there. If you run out and need a replacement, we can try and get you a replacement delivered - but - depending on timing - it may be faster for you to run and exchange the empty.

Of course we will reimburse you for the tank and your time!

In the game room, you’ll find a small selection of board games, card games, foosball, darts, and arcades for endless fun. If anything is missing or broken, please let us know immediately so we can order a replacement right away!

There should be a set of all-weather white cornhole boards in the back yard. If you notice anything is broken or missing PLEASE LET US KNOW RIGHT AWAY - so we can order replacements.

It would be very helpful if you would return them to the storage bin after each use so they don't wander off :)

There should be a set of all-weather cornhole boards somewhere on the patio. If you notice anything is broken or missing, please let us know right away so we can order replacements. It would be very helpful if you would return them to a covered area after each day so they don't wander off or get ruined in the weather :)

The pool can be heated for an additional $50/day fee for the duration of your stay. Please let us know ahead of time if you would like to heat the pool to a comfortable 85*F for your stay! We will have it warm upon your arrival as long as your balance is up to date. The pool takes about a full day to go from cold to the "desired temp' so please don't wait until you arrive to decide :)

Do Not Touch the Pool Equipment!

If you would like directions on how to turn on the waterfall please just ask. Never adjust the heater or pump equipment without consulting your hosts first. We do not want to cause any damage that requires a pool technician to come to the home for a service fee at the guest's expense.

Please Do Not Lower The Thermostat Below 72*. Florida gets hot in the summer. But lowering the temp too much will damage the HVAC units and freeze the components. We learned that lesson the hard way :(

When you arrive, the thermostat should be set somewhere between 72-74*F - but you can adjust somewhat if you need. If you're running the air conditioning or heating - PLEASE keep all windows and outside doors closed to ensure it operates at maximum efficiency.
